verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the Fig and the Olive,
verse.verse_4: That We created man of finest possibilities,
verse.verse_5: Then brought him down to the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: Except those who believe and do the right, for whom there is reward undiminished.
verse.verse_7: Who should then make you deny the Judgement after this?
verse.verse_8: Is not God the most equitable of all judges?
